name: wds_vtab-resisc45
description: RESISC45 is a remote-sensing scene classification dataset providing labeled aerial/remote images across 45 scene classes. The wds_vtab-resisc45 variant packages this dataset for use with WebDataset/VTAB-style evaluation pipelines. It measures a model's ability to perform multiclass image scene classification on diverse land-use and land-cover categories.
reputation: A well-known and widely used remote sensing / scene-classification benchmark in the computer vision and geospatial ML communities.
